goal:
Implement add-biscuit-profiles login profiles on the existing runtime. Do not add a second Biscuit library.

Runtime (usable, e5a6045): Mjolnir.Biscuit in lib/mjolnir/biscuit.ex and native/mjolnir_biscuit. Call it. Do not edit that crate.

Contract: openspec/changes/add-biscuit-profiles/design.md Decisions 1-8 and specs/edge-auth/spec.md. Advise accept is reviews/2026-09-24-advise-3.md.

Land a module lib/mjolnir/auth/login_profile.ex that:
- Mints holder-bound by default: authority fact login_mode("holder") plus check if holder($fp). Session public is authorized at mint; verifier injects holder only after a valid login-proof. Stolen token (no proof / wrong key) fails.
- Mints explicit bearer: login_mode("bearer"), shorter exp and a strictly smaller right-set than the holder issuance for the same subject. Mode is authority-block only.
- Rejects absent/unknown/conflicting modes, token-supplied holder facts, and attenuation that drops the holder check or overrides mode.
- Login-proof is canonical dCBOR of the Decision 7 8-tuple, signed by the session key. Nonce store is injected (a test double is fine). Unknown/expired/replayed nonce fails closed. Do not build HTTP endpoints (add-direct-auth-endpoints).
- One-shot authorize/4 result: allow or deny for this request. Deny does not fall back to JWT. Foreign root and expiry deny.
- Tests in test/mjolnir/auth/login_profile_test.exs cover signature requirement, stolen token, attenuation, edge/audience binding, explicit bearer, expiry, downgrade.

Check the five open implement boxes in openspec/changes/add-biscuit-profiles/tasks.md when the tests pass. Edit and stop. Conductor persists. Do not fold. Do not git push.

anchors.invariant: Only mint/verify runtime. No second biscuit-auth stack.
Authority-block fact holder or bearer. Verifier cannot downgrade holder to bearer.
